Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card when my opponent doesn't have a Digimon with 6000 DP or less in play to play a Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less from my hand without paying its memory cost?

Effect: [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less. Then, you may play 1 Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less from your hand without paying its memory cost.
